retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the local elections of 12 October 2025. The atlas keeps the first exercise of an institution and the ballot at which it became a cycle, and retracts the routine repetitions after them; the thirteenth local election is one. The only link available is the constitutional one the earlier records already carry. Revisit if a consequence is written.
